name: veracross-parent-digest
description: Browser extension: a private digest of the Veracross parent portal.

scripts.zip: rm -f dist/parent-digest.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/parent-digest.zip manifest.json src icons -x '*.DS_Store' 'src/pages/demo.js'
scripts.safari: rm -rf dist/safari dist/safari-ext && mkdir -p dist/safari-ext && cp -R manifest.json src icons dist/safari-ext/ && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari-ext --project-location dist/safari --app-name 'Parent Digest' --bundle-identifier com.jeffreywescott.Parent-Digest --swift --no-open --force
scripts.safari:sync: rm -rf dist/safari-ext/src dist/safari-ext/icons && cp -R manifest.json src icons dist/safari-ext/
